undated_600.reading: Static-regime retrieval gain among automatically UNSUPPORTED questions, regressed on log10 parameters over the published-count ladder. A negative slope means unsupported evidence costs more the more capable the generator -- the cost is borne by models with parametric knowledge to overwrite. Roster-confounded like every other scale statement in this paper.
